stories.title: CPSC Issues Urgent Magnetic Toy Recalls — Stop Use Immediately

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
RECALL: GBYMIUY Magnetic Stick Figures (10,750 units) — STOP use immediately.

Swallowed magnets attract each other inside the body. Risk of perforation, blockage, or death.

Full refund from GBYMIUY.

#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Two magnetic toy recalls this week — GBYMIUY Stick Figures and Vndueey Magnetic Men.

Both linked to death or serious injury from magnet ingestion.

Take them away from kids. Contact seller for a refund.

#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

article.headline: CPSC Recalls Magnetic Toy Sets — Stop Use Immediately, Risk of Death

image_concepts.label: Image

CPSC Magnetic Toy Recalls

**IMAGE 2A — Social (1200x675)**
- Mode: base_only

Bright studio lighting. Clean white bottom third with subtle shadows. No text, no brand logos, no children. Photorealistic product-style photography.
- Usage: X post, Facebook

**IMAGE 2B — Article Hero (1200x630)**
- Mode: base_only
- Prompt: Close-up of small round high-powered magnets on a light wood surface, slightly blurred background suggesting a playroom or living room. Warm but cautionary lighting. Clear, open bottom third. No text, no children. Photorealistic, slightly somber tone suggesting caution.
- Usage: Article hero

---

research.facts:
CPSC Magnetic Toy Recalls
**Sources consulted:**
- cpsc.gov — "Magnetic Stick Figure Sets Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Magnet Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys; Sold on Walmart by BlissfulDestiny" (GBYMIUY, 10,750 units)
- cpsc.gov — "Vndueey Magnetic Men Toy Sets Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Magnet Ingestion; Violates Mandatory Standard for Toys"
- cpsc.gov — "CPSC Warns Consumers to Immediately Stop Using Vndueey Magnet Men Toy Sets..."
- playsafe.org — "Toy Recalls - 2026 Recalls"
**Verified facts (HIGH):**
- GBYMIUY Magnetic Stick Figure Sets recalled October 1, 2026 — cpsc.gov
- 10,750 units affected (GBYMIUY/BlissfulDestiny Walmart listing) — cpsc.gov
- Vndueey Magnetic Men Toy Sets also recalled — cpsc.gov
- Hazard: loose high-powered magnets that can be ingested — cpsc.gov
- Ingestion risk: magnets attract inside digestive system, causing intestinal perforations, blockage, infection, blood poisoning, death — cpsc.gov
- Action: take away from children immediately, stop use, contact for full refund — cpsc.gov
- GBYMIUY contact required for refund — cpsc.gov
**Verified facts (MEDIUM):**
- Other similar recalls also issued in 2026: Generic Magnetic Ball Sets (Ritons, Amazon), GLMZZ Fidget Magnet Ball Toys — cpsc.gov (pattern of multiple brands)
